notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Kiki-Jiki.
You control at least one nonlegendary creature with power 1 or greater.
description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of any nonlegendary creature you control that has power 1 or greater with haste.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Kiki-Jiki triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the creature token's power.
Repeat.
